children: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions announced RAD's ROSA and RIO integration with Immix is now live following successful user acceptance testing.
RAD integration with Immix now available to Immix users after UAT and months of joint engineering.
Largest U.S. guarding and monitoring firm validated functionality; a second large firm begins evaluation.
Integration embeds ROSA and RIO into existing Immix workflows, reducing operational friction for central stations.
Supported RAD devices provide alarm footage, pre-alarm recording, audio transmit and relay control for active response.
Planned expansion includes AVA support in 2027 and evaluation of additional devices and features based on customer feedback.
